summary: Guarded configuration apply: reads this[41] (+0xA4) and, when a2 < value and value < 8, runs a fixed group of four field setters with constants (0x400000, two zeros, float 1.0 twice, and 4). Always returns 0. The caller D3DTextureResourceCreation context suggests per-resource configuration, but the target object and meaning of the constant arguments are external.

Guard on a2 < v2 and v2 < 8; the setter group runs only when both comparisons hold.

ShortComputation_fd30(1065353216, 1065353216) - computation setter fed the literal 1065353216 (single-precision 1.0) twice.
